card.name: Subject nouns in news headlines
card.fires_on: The subject noun (e.g. woman, Developers, school, scientists) at the start of a news headline, just before the action verb. Also seen in citation lists of article titles.

modes.label: Headline subject
modes.description: A plural or generic subject noun in a headline, right before its verb.
